$comment: SM030: one published document inside a source - an Act, a principal's specification, an approval type, an award, a licence. One file per instrument under obligations/<jurisdiction>/, holding the instrument itself plus every obligation it imposes. Fields mirror `Instrument` in the monorepo's onboarding.ts prototype; `obligations` is new - the prototype's sample data keeps instrument and obligation in two separate arrays joined by id, this repository nests them so one pull request is reviewable as one instrument.
title: instrument v1

id.description: stable slug, e.g. `bif_act`. Referenced by a project's `project_obligation` fact once switched on.

source.description: which of the seven sources this instrument belongs to - a member of vocab/sources.json

instrument_type.description: the kind of document within its source - a member of vocab/instrument_types.json[source]

jurisdictions.description: where it applies - members of vocab/jurisdictions.json. A country code applies to every one of its states/regions too.

form.description: for a `contract` source instrument: the conditions-of-contract id it belongs to (e.g. `AS4000_1997`), matching `contract_terms.contract_form`

version.description: the edition or legislation version date read

obligations.description: every duty this instrument imposes - each conforms to obligation.schema.json
